description: Canonical security-domain labels for Arkret detached proofs and non-Event cryptographic transcripts. contexts remain schema-bound; domain_separations cover hash, signature, Merkle, HPKE-info and replay-cache-namespace separators and are not a general string registry. A replay_cache_namespace row separates replay-ledger partitions, never a signing transcript, and MUST NOT be carried by a wire or fixture field named proof_context.
registry_rules: context values and object_family values MUST be unique
Every Arkret non-Event schema that uses event-envelope.schema.json#/$defs/proof MUST register an object-family context here

contexts[] closure is triggered by a terminal use point of the shared event-envelope.schema.json#/$defs/proof leaf. A non-Event schema that declares its own local detached-proof or signature leaf instead of referencing the shared leaf is outside contexts[] by construction and MUST NOT be registered there

Such a locally anchored signing domain MUST instead appear in domain_separations[] with primitive detached_signature and binding_fields naming the transcript fields its proof covers, so that membership of this file is decidable from the schema alone rather than by convention
A verifier MUST reject a valid signature made under a context registered to a different object family
Every contexts[] schema_ref MUST resolve a terminal use point of the shared event-envelope detached-proof leaf; an explicitly annotated local signing domain belongs only in domain_separations[]

For any domain_separations[] row that declares schema_ref or transcript_schema_refs, every binding field MUST occur in those registered transcript schemas unless injected_fields explicitly records its outer-carrier, constant, or pure-function source
schema_ref MUST resolve to a real node: the file part MUST exist and the JSON Pointer fragment, when present, MUST resolve to a schema object

Every terminal use point of the shared detached-proof leaf (a schema node whose $ref chain terminates at event-envelope.schema.json#/$defs/proof and that no other node references) MUST be covered by exactly one most-specific row here; a fragmentless schema_ref is exact only when the file root itself is the object family
A row whose schema_ref subtree contains shared-proof use points that all belong to deeper rows is over-broad and MUST be tightened to the inner $defs node it actually describes

One shared wire leaf MAY carry several consumer contexts. Every row anchored on a shared anchor MUST declare a distinct consumer_operation from operation-registry.json, and the anchored schema node MUST list exactly those contexts in x-arkret-proof-contexts
A schema node MAY project its single context as x-arkret-proof-context; when both the annotation and a registry row exist they MUST agree byte-for-byte

A shared-proof use point whose enclosing top-level $defs entry is reached by $ref from more than one other top-level $defs entry of the same file is a packed leaf. Unless every covering row declares its own consumer_operation, each object family MUST hold its own proof node and its own row; one row MUST NOT stand for several request/outcome families

domain_separations rows MUST have unique domain and object_family values, MUST NOT reuse a label or object_family already registered in contexts[], and MUST declare a primitive from the closed set canonical_json_sha256, merkle_leaf_sha256, merkle_node_sha256, merkle_root_sha256, detached_signature, http_message_signature, hpke_info, replay_cache_namespace

Every contexts[].context and domain_separations[].domain MUST match ak.<dot-separated snake_case symbol path>.v1. A dot separates naming levels, an underscore joins words inside one level, and a label MUST occur in exactly one array; the array and primitive, not delimiter spelling, determine its semantics. The ak.<kebab-case>-proof-v1 spelling is invalid and is not an alias

A replay_cache_namespace row MUST declare defined_in, and the normative document it names MUST contain the domain literal. Every fixture field named replay_cache_namespace MUST carry a registered replay_cache_namespace domain, and every fixture field named proof_context MUST carry a registered proof context

Every contexts[] row, and every domain_separations[] row whose primitive is detached_signature, names an object_family that some producer signs and some receiver verifies as a wire object, so it MUST resolve to a registered schema: the row declares schema_ref or a non-empty transcript_schema_refs, every referenced file is an active row of registry/schema-registry.json, every reference resolves to a real schema object, and that node is covered by a registered ak.schema.*.v1 id. Primitives that bind bytes assembled from an enclosing carrier (merkle_*, hpke_info, replay_cache_namespace, canonical_json_sha256, http_message_signature) are outside this rule by construction. machine gate: tools/artifact_lint:proof_context_object_family_schemas

Those carrier-bound rows are still not free-floating: each MUST declare an independent definition through schema_ref, transcript_schema_refs, defined_in or transcript_defined_in. A bare object_family or domain occurrence in prose, a schema, a fixture, a profile or a generated view is not a definition and MUST NOT anchor the row. Every declared schema reference and prose fragment MUST resolve through its owning reference gate. Rows registered before this rule and not yet adjudicated are named in tools/proof-context-anchor-exemptions.json, which is a ratchet: a listed family that acquires an anchor MUST be removed from it. machine gate: tools/artifact_lint:proof_context_carrier_family_anchors

No binding_fields entry of either array may name a field that forbidden-wire-fields.json forbids in the producer_event_envelope_root context. A field that can never appear on the wire cannot be hashed into a commitment, and skipping it silently discards the separation the row exists to provide. machine gate: tools/artifact_lint:domain_separation_binding_fields_are_carriable

Every domain_separations[] row whose primitive is canonical_json_sha256 MUST select exactly one digest_constructions[] row, carry the exact UTF-8 hex encoding of domain followed by one LF byte, name the normative transcript definition, and declare either a resolvable known_answer_ref or a non-empty kat_absence_reason plus owner_report. digest_constructions[] and these row extensions are closed objects. machine gate: tools/artifact_lint:digest_construction_registration

A non-JCS raw UTF-8 literal digest MAY select domain_prefixed_utf8_literal_sha256 from an owning source-of-truth registry only when that registry closes the exact domain, literal source, output encoding and a byte-exact known-answer fixture. Such a selector is not a domain_separations[] proof/signature context and MUST have a dedicated gate that proves every registered use and KAT. The Agent draft Account Data key is the v1 registered use.

A detached_signature row whose local closed schema directly requires signature and signature_algorithm MUST list exactly that schema's required members other than signature in binding_fields. signature_algorithm is itself signed and MUST select an active raw_signature_algorithm; an outer object that merely carries a shared proof leaf is outside this equality rule. machine gate: tools/artifact_lint:local_signature_binding_fields_match_schema

A closed locator schema that contains neither the shared detached-proof leaf nor a local signature member MUST NOT acquire a proof context. realm_join_candidate is an untrusted authority-bundle locator and is permanently outside contexts[] and domain_separations[]. machine gate: tools/artifact_lint:realm_join_candidate_untrusted_locator

The six detached-object-signature.schema.json context branches MUST map one-to-one to detached_signature rows. Each row closes the host schema, signature member exclusions, JCS/SHA-256 digest, UTF8(domain + LF) prefix, five-member signed envelope, Ed25519 encoding, signer authority and byte KAT. A verifier MUST reconstruct every byte from the host and registered domain rather than trusting signed_digest or fixture expected fields. machine gate: tools/artifact_lint:detached_object_signature_registration

digest_constructions.canonicalization: schema-validated canonical literal encoded directly as UTF-8; no JCS, normalization, truncation or decoding fallback
digest_constructions.digest_encoding: base64url_no_pad of the complete 32-byte digest, exactly 43 ASCII characters

injected_fields.source: Method-native digest derived from the verified entry pinned by did_version_id; not an independently supplied wire field. See identity/account-lifecycle.md.
authenticated pairing record pairing_code, byte-identical to the runtime request pairing_code

contexts.regime_rule: Exactly one producer proof applies. The current governance Station resolves the verification method and records acceptance in RealmCommit.

injected_fields.source: pure function: the RFC 8785 JCS bytes of this policy object with auth_data removed

domain_separations.conditional_binding_rule: kind=did_root MUST omit proof_body; kind in recovery_unlock|device_quorum|trusted_recovery_service MUST include the matching closed signature-independent proof_body projection

injected_fields.source: pure function: the RFC 8785 JCS bytes of this receipt object with auth_data removed

domain_separations.signer_authority: governance_generation exact governance Station service signing key authorized by the verified authority chain; verification_method belongs to that exact service identity
from_generation and from_service_id exact old governance Station service signing key that remains current at the frozen handoff cut
to_generation and to_service_id exact new governance Station service signing key after complete validation and import of the frozen handoff
current_generation and current_service_id exact current governance Station service signing key derived from the verified genesis-to-handoff chain
governance_generation exact current governance Station service signing key verified through the current authority bundle
commit_event_ref exact winning ak.mls.commit Event producer signing authority and its already verified verification_method
